summary.intent: Complete Phase 23 (Rust SDK Extraction) gap closure execution, run a security review on the extracted crates, fix security findings, add test coverage to address low Codecov scores, and merge the work into a PR.
summary.outcome: All 8 plans of Phase 23 executed and verified; PR #352 created with 163 new unit tests, two HIGH security fixes (Ed25519 zeroization, Zeroizing return type), multiple CI fixes, and all CodeRabbit/Copilot review comments resolved across three rounds.

repo: fuser (Unix FUSE library) is vendored at apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/fuser and patched via workspace [patch.crates-io], causing it to be resolved on all platforms including Windows even when unused

The workspace uses [patch.crates-io] for fuser, which forces Cargo to resolve and attempt to compile it on all targets regardless of feature flags — fixed by moving fuser to [target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
ed25519-dalek's SigningKey does not zero on drop unless the 'zeroize' feature is explicitly enabled in workspace Cargo.toml
generate_ed25519_keypair callers were wrapping the returned Vec<u8> in redundant Zeroizing::new() — the function now returns Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> directly
CI collects Rust coverage via cargo llvm-cov --workspace on Linux; any added unit tests automatically improve Codecov reporting
The cross-language parity job was missing pnpm version: 10 in its setup-node step, causing it to fail
IpnsPublishRequest derived Debug, leaking encrypted IPNS key material in log output — requires custom Debug impl
fetch_and_populate_folder and resolve_file_pointers_blocking existed in both macOS/Linux and Windows operations.rs files but had no external callers — dead code across both platform paths

code.finding: generate_ed25519_keypair returned bare Vec<u8> for private key; changed to Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> to ensure memory zeroing on drop

Callers wrapped generate_ed25519_keypair result in redundant Zeroizing::new(); also Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>.try_into() for [u8;32] requires .into_inner() first since Zeroizing doesn't implement TryInto<[u8;32]>
ipns_private_key.try_into() for [u8;32] fails with Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>; must call .into_inner().try_into()
Vendored fuser build.rs panics on Windows via unimplemented!() — added early return for Windows target, though the real fix was moving fuser to cfg(unix) target dependencies
Copy-paste bug: app_version field was being set to device_info.device_id instead of device_info.app_version — caught by Copilot review
Key length cast to u8 via 'as u8' would silently truncate for keys >255 bytes; changed to u16 with proper varint encoding
get_bytes method existed but had zero callers — removed as dead code rather than fixing missing status code check
Temp directory cleanup was happening before unmount, leaving filesystem in inconsistent state on error paths; moved cleanup after unmount in all code paths
? operator on logout was propagating transport errors that should be best-effort; changed to match to handle gracefully

workflow: GSD execute-phase workflow: when a subagent disconnects mid-execution, check git log for completed task commits, verify acceptance criteria, then manually complete bookkeeping (SUMMARY.md, STATE.md, ROADMAP.md) rather than re-running the whole plan
Cargo workspace [patch.crates-io] applies to ALL workspace members regardless of feature flags — use [target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies] to truly gate Unix-only crates from Windows compilation
CodeRabbit runs multiple review rounds as new commits are pushed; each round generates new unresolved threads requiring another resolve-pr-comments pass
1Password SSH agent can transiently fail to sign commits; retrying after a pause resolves the issue most of the time
Parallel subagent test writing (one agent per crate) is effective for adding coverage quickly — all three agents completed independently without conflicts
Security review should be committed to .planning/security/ and included in PRs as documentation artifacts

friction: 1Password SSH agent failed to sign commits multiple times throughout the session, requiring repeated retries
API connection refused mid-wave-execution caused the gsd-executor subagent to disconnect, requiring manual resume and bookkeeping

Windows cargo check failed twice: first due to vendored fuser build.rs panicking, then again because moving the build.rs fix wasn't enough — the Rust source itself compiled on Windows via the workspace patch
CodeRabbit posted the same ECIES min-size comment across three separate review rounds despite being marked 'not applicable' each time
gh CLI log fetching required multiple attempts with different flags to extract actual compiler errors from CI job output
Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>.try_into::<[u8;32]>() doesn't work directly — requires .into_inner() first, which wasn't immediately obvious
open_items: AES-CTR ciphertext integrity: client doesn't verify IPFS CID after fetching bytes, meaning a malicious relay could serve tampered ciphertext with predictable bit-flip impact — MEDIUM finding left unaddressed

file_ipns_private_key in write_ops.rs uses ed25519_dalek directly (not generate_ed25519_keypair) and returns plain Vec<u8> without Zeroizing — secondary key generation path not covered by the zeroization fix
build_folder_metadata extracts Zeroizing<Vec<u8>> via .to_vec() returning plain Vec<u8> — the extraction pattern leaks zeroization protection for inode-stored keys passed to spawn_metadata_publish
ed25519-dalek zeroize feature now enabled workspace-wide — should verify no other crates have conflicting feature requirements
~30 test case suggestions from the security review (attack scenarios, replay/nonce-reuse, padding oracle) were generated but not implemented as actual tests
